title: DetectionVerdict
description: PINNED 2026-05-31. THE canonical detection-battery standard: the unit every detector emits. It is a schema, NOT a fixed list of detectors (web/index.html). One DetectionVerdict ties together the five folds of the provenance substrate over a single content-addressed node: decision (carrier Four), confidence (score), the empirical W-grounding, the guarantee tier earned on THIS input, the custody/feed-liveness verdict, and the provenance node that justifies all of it on demand. A detector conforms to canon iff it emits this. See ../design/self_validation_architecture.md and carrier.md / guarantee_certificate.schema.json / custody.md.

belnap.description: A carrier.md Belnap Four value as a string. none=(0,0) no info; true=(1,0); false=(0,1); both=(1,1) contradiction. NOT a bare bool — an unanswered question is 'none', never 'false' (absence of evidence != evidence of absence).

cid.description: A content address per cid.md (a node's recipe CID = its prov:Entity id). Justification is reachable by walking the provenance DAG from this id.

w_record.description: The five W's — the empirical grounding that turns a semantic technique label into checkable telemetry facts. Each W is itself a Belnap-typed claim with its own provenance node (recursively justified); an unanswered W is 'none', never 'false'.

when.description: temporal window satisfied? (the temporal fold's verdict)

provenance.description: CID of this W-record's own DAG node

technique.description: ATT&CK id (e.g. T1558.003) — the semantic label, itself a validatable hypothesis, never the bedrock.

score.description: The calibrated detector statistic (the confidence fold's graded axis, e.g. a fused log-odds or its probability). Orthogonal to 'decision' — a score near equipoise with decision='both' is a contradiction, not genuine 0.5 (carrier.md two-axes rule).

decision.description: The detect/validate projection of the temporal/confidence folds. 'both' = an exists-detect path and a forall-validate path disagreed (the soundness alarm).

guarantee.description: The GuaranteeCertificate (guarantee_certificate.schema.json) — the tier this result EARNED on this input, demotable per result. Referenced by shape here; validated in full by that schema.

custody.description: The custody fold's verdict at ingest: true=signed+live+digest-matched, false=tampered, none=silent/unsigned feed. Feed-liveness IS custody (architecture §6); the signal the temporal fold's negation depends on.

provenance.description: CID of the lazy provenance DAG node this verdict is about — full justification on demand. The one object all the other folds are interpretations of (justification IS the result, not a side-log).
